name: Solutions Partner designation
short_description: Microsoft AI Cloud Partner Program designation per solution area, such as Modern Work, Security or Data & AI, earned by reaching the required Partner Capability Score; it replaced the former Silver and Gold competencies.

evidence.quote: That's the shift separating gold partners from solutions partners
